key_insight: Preparing and consuming logical resource states enables addressable, parallel universal fault-tolerant computation in high-rate concatenated quantum codes.
engineering_relevance: This architecture shifts logical-gate implementation toward resource-state preparation and error-correcting teleportation, offering a route to lower fault-tolerant computing overhead.
method: Concatenate small-distance, high-rate self-dual CSS codes.
Prepare logical CSS stabilizer states with flag-at-origin and global magic states with concatenated cultivation.
Consume resources through Steane-QEC or Knill-QEC teleportation, requiring at most 12 resource states per T-depth layer.
evidence_signal: Resource-preparation benchmarks for several two-level concatenations of H codes and the [[15,7,3]] Hamming code report at least a tenfold spacetime reduction for concatenated cultivation versus surface-code cultivation.
watch_item: The reported advantage concerns resource preparation; full-system benefits require evaluating hardware connectivity, noise assumptions, and resource delivery overhead.
paper_title: Injection is all you need: parallel universal logic in high-rate concatenated self-dual codes
